goal.name: WebOS Self-Evolving Autonomous Software Engineering & Computational Intelligence
goal.description: A persistent, self-understanding, goal-driven autonomous software engineering system capable of transforming high-level human objectives into functioning computational systems under PrimeGate governance.

requirements: Transform human intent into concrete architectural models without requiring human implementation directive
Autonomous understanding, architectural cognition, requirement derivation, dependency reasoning, and gap analysis
Governed mutation execution via PrimeGate with zero silent failures or unhandled exceptions
Human-readable real-time telemetry: current action, progress steps, timing estimates, activity/heartbeat status
Continuous experience accumulation, learning from evidence, and automatic roadmap reassessment
constraints: No parallel executor, second authority layer, or ungoverned shadow runtime
Preserve strict claim != evidence verification principle
Human operates as Goal Owner rather than Implementation Director

known_gaps.description: Capability 'Continuous Experience & Learning Feedback' is incomplete or unverified

risks: Architectural drift if non-governed source mutations occur
Unverified runtime integration if end-to-end tests are bypassed

candidate_approaches.title: Modular Inversion & Interface Contracts
candidate_approaches.approach_summary: Decompose components behind explicit interface contracts and dependency inversion.
pros: Extensible for future systems without core modification
tradeoffs: Favors long-term maintainability and safety over quick single-file patches
candidate_approaches.rationale: Aligns best with clean architecture, modularity, and long-term extensibility principles retrieved from Azure & SEI knowledge.

candidate_approaches.title: Monolithic Direct Modification
candidate_approaches.approach_summary: Directly append logic to existing core files without abstraction boundaries.
cons: High coupling and risk of architectural drift
Harder to test and maintain independently
tradeoffs: Trades off long-term stability and extensibility for immediate execution speed
candidate_approaches.rationale: Rejected due to high coupling and risk of architectural debt.
